run_convolve2d_solver: run the convolve2d full fill solver on a tuple of two 2D numpy arrays
solve_convolution: solve the 2D convolution of two matrices using scipy signal convolve2d in full mode
validate_convolution_solution: validate a convolution result against the reference implementation within a tolerance of 1e-6
refactor_convolve2d_solve: refactor the Convolve2DFullFill solve method to use FFT-based convolution for better performance
review_convolve2d_class: review the Convolve2DFullFill class and its solve and is_solution methods for correctness
